text.tspan: Regions of interest are partitioned into super regions; each thread runs a metrics worker that processes one super region at a time. Each worker may process multiple regions.
The worker fetches reads overlapping the super region and walks each read in sorted order, collecting raw data used from each read for metrics calculation.
Case 2: Starts outside current super region,
not inside any prior super reigon
